name: Blue Marvel

abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Crush: Blokları kırarak yüksek hasar vermeyi sağlar.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Overload: Vuruşlar, yakın zamanda verilen hasarın bir kısmını ek enerji hasarı olarak verir.
abilityDetails.Provoke: Etkilenen şampiyon, vuruş mesafesi dışındayken %40 daha saldırgan hale gelir.
abilityDetails.Wither: Rakibin güç kazanma ve iyileşme etkilerini zayıflatır.

signatureAbility:
The Most Powerful Man in America
Before taking non-hit Direct Damage from Champions, gain an Indestructible Passive for [1.5 - 8] seconds. Cooldown: 35 seconds. Cooldown is removed when Blue Marvel is Rooted.
Start each fight with a number of personal Cruelty Passives equal to [10 - 25]% of Persistent Antimatter, rounded down.

abilitySections.title: Living Antimatter Reactor - Always Active
content: As a living stable antimatter reaction, Blue Marvel warps the laws of physics to his benefit. His attacks deal Energy Damage and do not make contact with non-Skill Opponents.
Due to his unique composition, Blue Marvel is Immune to Bleed and Power Steal, and his Combat Power Rate cannot be reduced below 80%.
Blue Marvel does not gain a Precision Buff when using the Dexterity Mastery. Instead he gains a +[485.29] Energy Resistance Passive for 5 seconds. Max stacks: 3.

Blue Marvel's thunderous blows will not be denied. His Heavy Attacks cannot Miss, and when Punishing a Mystic Opponent's Heavy or Special Attack with a Medium Attack, he inflicts a Crush Debuff for 2.5 seconds.
Light Attacks 2, 3, and 4 inflict a 1% Weakness Debuff for 10 seconds. Max stacks: 5.

abilitySections.title: Antimatter Charges - Max: 60
content: +1 Charge when the Opponent is inflicted with a non-Stun Debuff.
+3 Charges when the Opponent fills a Bar of Power.
+1 Charge when taking Energy Damage or Blocking a hit while not in Stable Release. Cooldown: 0.5 seconds.
For every 20 Charges Blue Marvel gains while not in Stable Release, and for every 8 seconds he spends in Stable Release, gain an indefinite +[144.74] Cruelty Passive.
At the end of a fight, store 1 Persistent Antimatter, plus an additional for each personal Cruelty gained after the start of the fight. Max stacks: 30.
At the start of each fight, gain dormant Charges equal to Persistent Antimatter. Activating a Special Attack converts up to 10 dormant Charges into Antimatter Charges.

abilitySections.title: Stable Release
content: When Blue Marvel reaches max Antimatter Charges, he enters Stable Release and the Charges begin to expire one at a time. Charges last 0.5 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks. Stable Release grants the following benefits:
Gain +[12,671.1] Attack Rating.
Gain +[2,750] Energy Penetration.
Attacks cannot Miss.
Intercepting the Opponent with a Basic Attack inflicts a personal Crush Debuff.
When Blue Marvel has no Antimatter Charges remaining, Stable Release ends and its effects are removed.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack
content: The first hit inflicts a 25% Overload Debuff for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
Tapping Block while performing the final hit focuses the blast, refreshing personal Overload Debuffs. If all three have more than 50% duration remaining, pause them for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Throw Down the Gauntlet
content: The first hit inflicts a non-stacking Provoke Debuff for 5 seconds. While this Debuff is active, striking the Opponent re-inflicts it with its remaining duration, which is fixed.
The final hit inflicts a 20% Wither Debuff for 30 seconds. Max stacks: 2. While the Opponent has more than 2 Bars of Power, these Withers reduce Ability Power Rate by an additional 30%.
The final hit refreshes personal Overload and Wither Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Point Blank
content: The bursts of damage dealt by personal Overload effects gain 65% additional potency during this attack.

Before each beam blast, Blue Marvel taps into his hyper-cosmic awareness to slow time. Tapping Block during this slowed time grants a +[1,178.57] Precision Passive for 25 seconds. This is easier during Stable Release.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Stay Down
content: Gain a non-stacking Regeneration Passive, healing 6% of Max Health over 8 seconds. While in Stable Release, this Passive pauses for 0.5 seconds when the Opponent is struck.
Inflict an indefinite 25% Overload Passive. Max stacks: 3.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Most Powerful Man in America
content: Before taking non-hit Direct Damage from Champions, gain an Indestructible Passive for [1.5 - 8] seconds. Cooldown: 35 seconds. Cooldown is removed when Blue Marvel is Rooted.
Start each fight with a number of personal Cruelty Passives equal to [10 - 25]% of Persistent Antimatter, rounded down.
